Burnham says he is 'finalising' cabinet ahead of becoming PM on Monday.
- Andy Burnham said he had still not decided who will be in his cabinet ahead of taking over from Sir Keir Starmer as PM on Monday.
- Quote (Burnham): "It would be somewhat premature and would, I think, cause complete chaos if you start half a reshuffle before you're in the position."
- Quote (Burnham): "I am finalising those decisions, and I will come to conclusions very shortly, and then I will announce those on Monday."
- Widespread speculation: Ed Miliband and Shabana Mahmood thought to be in running to replace Rachel Reeves as chancellor.
- Cabinet appointments to be announced Monday, following a reception with King Charles III.
- First speech as Labour leader at TUC HQ: appointments would reflect "all parts of our party" and "all communities".
